name: Vine climb down

v1.prompt: The cat climbs down a thick vertical vine backwards, seen from the side: body vertical, head up, back paws reach down and grip in turn, front paws follow. The cat stays centred in the frame; the vine is a green vertical rope in front of the cat's belly. Seamless loop.  Static camera, no zoom, pan or tilt; strict side view. Keep the exact painting style, colours, light and outline of the image. The cat stays the same size in every frame.

verdict: usable/weak: cat mostly paws at a thin vine through its body; vine differs from 08/10. Suggest 08 played in reverse instead
suggest: prefer 08 reversed; if used, 25 frames at 12 fps
redoWithBetterBase: redo with a better base (a clinging-to-vine painting)
